nights.title: Ocean Colour Scene
nights.name: Ocean Colour Scene
nights.extract: Ocean Colour Scene are an English rock band formed in Moseley, Birmingham in 1989. They have had five top 10 albums, including a number one in 1997. They have also achieved seventeen top 40 singles and six top 10 singles to date.

en.who: Ocean Colour Scene are an English rock band formed in Moseley, Birmingham in 1989.

They have also achieved seventeen top 40 singles and six top 10 singles to date.

de.who: Ocean Colour Scene sind eine englische Rockband, die 1989 in Moseley, Birmingham gegründet wurde.

Außerdem erreichten sie siebzehn Top-40-Singles und sechs Top-10-Singles bis heute.

facts: 1997'de bir numaraya ulaşan albüm dahil beş ilk 10 albümleri oldu.
Bugüne kadar ayrıca on yedi ilk 40 single ve altı ilk 10 single'a ulaştılar.

nights.title: Republica - 30 Years of Ready To Go
nights.name: Republica
nights.extract: Republica are an English alternative rock band formed in 1994. They reached the height of their popularity from 1996 to 1999. The band went on hiatus in 2001 and reunited in 2008.

nights.title: Rizzle Kicks
nights.name: Rizzle Kicks
nights.extract: Rizzle Kicks are a British hip-hop duo from Brighton, England, consisting of Jordan "Rizzle" Stephens and Harley "Sylvester" Alexander-Sule. Their debut album, Stereo Typical, was released in 2011. As of May 2012, Rizzle Kicks had sold over one million singles and over 600,000 albums in the UK.

nights.title: CATTY
nights.name: Catty
nights.extract: Catrin Hopkins, known professionally as CATTY, is a Welsh singer and songwriter. She began her music career in 2016 in the musical duo Dusky Grey, before becoming a solo artist and a songwriter. Since going solo, she has released the extended plays Healing Out of Spite and Bracing for Impact, as well as supporting various artists on tour, including Dylan and Stevie Nicks.

nights.title: Boko Yout
nights.name: Boko Yout
nights.extract: Boko Yout is a Swedish music group. Previously, the group's singer Paul Adamah, born 1998 in Örebro, used the name Boko Yout as a stage name for his solo project, but since 2025 Boko Yout became a group with the addition of Kevin Stierne on bass and Joel Kiviaho on drums.

tr.who: Boko Yout bir İsveçli müzik grubudur. Grubun şarkıcısı Paul Adamah, adı önce solo projesi için sahne adı olarak kullanmıştı.

nights.title: Gloryhammer
nights.name: Gloryhammer
nights.extract: Gloryhammer are a British power metal band founded by keyboardist Christopher Bowes, lead vocalist of the band Alestorm. Each member of the band represents a character in the story concept. Band members appear on stage in armour and costumes to represent their respective characters.

nights.title: Fontaines D.C.
nights.name: Fontaines D.C.
